Celebrate Hari Malaysia with us this year 🇲🇾

Join Tanoti at Rentak Malaysiaku: Slice of Life by GMBB for a Mini Craft Workshop featuring Songket Weaving & Rattan Plaiting. Learn the basics of Sarawakian craft from our team and bring home a handmade piece of your own.

12 – 13 September 2026
The Grey Box, GMBB
11.00 a.m. – 08.00 p.m.
Children (7+) & Adults are welcome to join

Spots are limited – register early to lock in the RM100 early bird price (RM135 walk-in). Scan the QR code to secure your seat / DM us.

#TanotiCrafts #RentakMalaysiaku #HariMalaysia #SarawakianCraft #SongketWeaving

MAYBANK Bali Marathon 2026
23 August 2026 - Gianyar Bali

A total of 14k runners took part in the event and runsite was open for 2 days prior for racepack collection. The atmosphere was lively and the sunny weather lifted the energy.

Maybank Foundation took to the Sustainability Pavilion, showcasing its many wonderful programmes - this year, its flagship Maybank Women Eco-Weavers Programme was the spotlight. The Sustainability Pavilion was a wonderful treat to everyone who come through. There were treated to weaving demonstrations and weaved products of partner communities @mulberries_laos @colorsilk_cambodia @tanoticrafts @sekarkawung_id @anthillfabric.

The MWEW Runway Show featured delectable weaved fashion of its partner communities @mulberries_laos @colorsilk_cambodia @tanoticrafts @sekarkawung_id @anthillfabric, in partnership with @adidas.

At the Sustainability Pavilion, the public were also invited to participate in simple weaving workshops to learn specific processes of weaving.

MAYBANK Bali Marathon 2026
23 August 2026 - Gianyar, Bali

Congratulations to all our weaver partners on their awards, and thank you to Maybank Foundation for acknowledging the work that we have done with our partnership under the Maybank Women Eco-Weavers programme - @mulberries, @coloursilk @tanoticrafts @sekarkawung @anthill. We are so grateful to be able to grow and empower women weavers in Malaysia and throughout ASEAN.
